title: Bolt lengths: a shift or chance?
intro: A machine cuts bolts with mean length μ = 50.00 mm and standard deviation σ = 0.20 mm when it is set correctly. Every hour an inspector measures **n = 25** bolts. This hour the mean is **x̄ = 50.09 mm**. How likely is a sample mean this high if the machine is still set correctly?
